challenges.title: Challenges with Legacy Financial Systems
challenges.lead: Legacy systems are slow and outdated, which may hinder your growth in the modern world.

items.title: Monolithic Software
items.body: Monolithic software is hard to scale as they are quite rigid, and even a single update may cost you a lot.

items.title: Outdated Architecture
items.body: Outdated architecture often fails to integrate with modern utilities and API, which prevents you from giving top-notch customer service.

items.title: Data and Security Risk
items.body: Legacy systems can be easily penetrated by hackers, which may increase the chances of data leaks.

items.title: Compliance Incompatibility
items.body: Outdated technology and rigid architecture are two main pillars of a legacy system that prevents it from following modern regulations.

items.title: Slow Performance
items.body: Legacy systems run on outdated components, which results in lagging of the application, slow response time, and failure in the data handling process.

items.title: Dissatisfied Customers
items.body: Slow speed, outdated techniques, poor interface, and lack of real-time updates make customers unhappy and disappointed.
